propositions: Plan-review grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing/unverifiable even when a depends_on prerequisite ticket will create them, because grounding only checks origin/main snapshot and ignores ticket dependencies.
The prose rule in plan_review_G1G2.md stating 'a symbol created by a ticket this ticket depends_on is treated as EXISTING' is unwired and not enforced in the grounding logic.
An inline citation grammar [rebar:<ticket-id>] must be parsed and verified against both directions of the dependency graph: P.depends_on(C) or C.blocks(P), where both indicate C is upstream of P.

Layer-1 (det_citation.py) performs advisory edge verification with fail-closed semantics (never blocks); Layer-2 (LLM agent in G1G2/E4/E6) performs coverage judgment via show_ticket, crediting the symbol only if both the edge is verified and the cited ticket's plan/file_impact establishes the functionality.
An uncited citation, edge-unbacked citation, or coverage-unconfirmed citation must result in the finding standing (fail-closed), with no wrongful credit even on missing or network failures.
